_comment: Tongmyong University (Busan) campus data. Collected 2026-11-24 from the official sites tu.ac.kr/english, tu.ac.kr/tour and tour.tu.ac.kr/ic, plus the official campus map (map_250304). Building numbers/names come from the map legend; 'location' hints are read off the map relative to Main Gate 1 and other landmarks (not official walking directions). Set robot_location to where the robot will stand.
help_desk: the main office in the Main Building (Building 1), phone 051-629-3014

places.name: Main Building
places.location: Up the hill on the left side of campus, behind the round plaza (Circular Plaza, 34). From Main Gate 1, walk up the main road and turn left at the fountain.
places.inside: University administration. A rest area for students with disabilities is on the 1st floor.

places.name: Health and Welfare Building
places.location: Next to the Main Building (Building 1), on its right side, near the main road.
places.inside: College of Health, Welfare and Education.

places.name: Architecture and Design Building
places.location: On the left side of the Circular Plaza (34), below the Main Building.

places.name: Graduate School
places.location: Beside the main road, just up and to the left of the fountain, next to the Circular Plaza.

places.name: Architectural Engineering Practice Building
places.location: Far left, lower side of campus, next to the Student Union Building (6).

places.name: Student Union Building
places.location: Lower left side of campus, next to Tongmyong Stadium (7) and Parking Lot 1 (30).
places.inside: Student council and clubs. A club room for students with disabilities is on the 3rd floor. TU Career Support and the campus organizations association are in suite 207 of the Student Center.

places.name: Tongmyong Stadium
places.location: Lower left corner of campus, next to the Student Union Building (6).

places.name: Student Welfare Building and Cafeteria
places.location: Up the main road past the fountain, on the left, just below the big field (Main Field 1, 32) and next to Dormitory Building 2 (9).
places.inside: The university cafeteria. The menu has Korean dishes, international food, Muslim-friendly options and vegetarian choices.
places.source: campus map; tour.tu.ac.kr/ic/sub05_06.do (BIC news: University Cafeteria, Building No. 8)

places.name: Dormitory Building 2
places.location: Up the main road on the left, next to the Student Welfare Building (8), below the Central Library.
places.inside: Dormitory for domestic female students: 292 beds in 74 rooms. See the dormitory FAQ for rules and hours.

places.name: Central Library
places.location: At the top of the main road, behind the big field (Main Field 1, 32).
places.inside: Basement: big conference room and preservation library. 1st floor: open reading room and librarian desk. 3rd floor: humanities and social science books. 4th floor: engineering and architecture design books. 5th floor: language and literature books. 12 group study rooms on floors 3 to 5, for up to 8 people, booked on the library homepage.
places.hours: During the semester the open reading room on the 1st floor is open every day from 6 AM to 11 PM. The book rooms on floors 3 to 5 are open 9 AM to 9 PM on weekdays and closed on weekends and holidays. Vacation hours are shorter.
places.notes: Borrow books with your student ID card. Website: lib.tu.ac.kr

places.name: Tongmyong Hall
places.location: Upper right part of campus, near the top of the right-hand road, above the Companion Animal Building (12).

places.name: Companion Animal Building
places.location: Upper right part of campus, between Tongmyong Hall (11) and ICT Building 2 (13).

places.name: ICT Building 1
places.location: Upper middle of campus, to the right of the Central Library and the big field.
places.inside: College of ICT Convergence (School of AI, computer science, software, game and engineering departments use the ICT buildings).

places.name: ICT Building 2
places.location: Right side of campus along the upper road, next to ICT Building 3 (14).

places.name: ICT Building 3
places.location: Right side of campus, below ICT Building 2 (13).

places.name: Faculty Research Building
places.location: Middle right of campus, just below ICT Building 1 (15).

places.name: International College Building
places.location: Middle right of campus, next to the BIC office (19) and below the Faculty Research Building (16).
places.inside: Admissions office. Global Education Center (international admissions) in Room 304. A co-working space.

places.name: Tongmyong Technical High School
places.location: Right side of campus, along the road on the right, below the International College Building.
places.notes: This is a separate high school, not a university building.

places.name: Busan International College Office
places.location: Middle right of campus, next to the International College Building (17), near Yongma Plaza (26).
places.inside: Busan International College (English-taught programs) office and academic affairs: course registration, withdrawal, credit transfer, leave of absence. The BIC Student Community Center and Korean Language Clinic Center are in the International College Building.
places.notes: BIC programs: Global Business, AI and Computer Engineering, Information System and Security, Mechanical and Automotive Engineering, Global Korean Studies, Tech Management and Innovation, Digital Design and Marketing.

places.name: International Industry-Academia Cooperation Building
places.location: Lower right side of campus, along the road towards Gate 2.

places.name: Gaonnuri
places.location: Next to the main road, left of the big field (Main Field 1, 32), across from the Student Welfare Building.

places.name: Do-ing Hall
places.location: Just below the Circular Plaza (34), on the left side of the main road near the fountain.

places.name: Student Cafe
places.location: On the main road, between the Graduate School (4) and the Student Welfare Building (8).

places.name: Dormitory Building 1
places.location: At the very top of campus, above the upper area, up the hill past Seondang (23).
places.inside: Dormitory for domestic and international students: 671 beds in 229 rooms, 10 floors. Dining hall, convenience store, fitness center, laundry, kitchen, computer room and 24-hour study room. A room for students with disabilities is on the 2nd floor.

places.name: Sports Complex
places.location: In the middle of campus to the right of the main road, behind the Circulation Bus Stop (39), next to Parking Lot 3 (37).

places.name: Main Field 1
places.location: In the upper middle of campus, in front of the Central Library (10).
places.inside: Artificial turf field, used for events like BIC Sports Day.

places.name: Main Field 2
places.location: Middle of campus, right of the main road, below the Sports Complex (36).

places.name: Circular Plaza
places.location: In front of the Main Building (1), to the left of the fountain.

places.name: Yongma Plaza
places.location: Upper right of campus, between ICT Building 1 (15) and ICT Building 2 (13).

places.name: Campus Shuttle and Circulation Bus Stop
places.location: Next to the main road, right side, just above the fountain. The commuter shuttle stops in front of Parking Lot 3 (37), next to the tennis courts.
places.hours: Weekdays during the semester 8 AM to 7:20 PM: every 10 to 15 minutes until 11 AM, every 30 minutes from 11 AM to 4 PM, every 10 minutes after 4 PM. Vacation: 9 AM to 5 PM every 20 minutes, no service 11 AM to 3 PM. No shuttle on Saturdays, Sundays or holidays.
places.notes: Route: campus, UN crossroad, Daeyeon-dong intersection, Kyungsung University, back to campus. City stops: near Daeyeon Station exit 1 and Kyungsung University and Pukyong National University Station exit 5 (Metro Line 2).

places.name: Main Gate 1
places.location: At the bottom of campus. The main road runs from here up the hill past the parking booth and fountain.

places.name: Gate 2
places.location: Lower right corner of campus.

places.name: Gate 3
places.location: Right side of campus, on the road near ICT Building 3 (14).

places.name: Parking Lots
places.location: Parking Lot 1 (30) is lower left near the Student Union. Parking Lot 2 (31) is near Main Gate 1, right of the main road. Parking Lot 3 (37) is by the tennis courts and is the shuttle stop. Parking Lot 5 (38) is in the upper right corner. The parking control booth (35) is on the main road just inside Main Gate 1.

places.name: University Animal Hospital
places.location: Upper right corner of campus.

places.name: Green Startup Town and Startup Hub
places.location: Far upper right corner of campus.

places.name: Gardens and Rest Areas
places.location: The fountain (41) is on the main road just inside Main Gate 1. Maji Garden (40) is the pond garden right of the main road near Main Gate 1. Tongmyong Garden (44) is at the top of campus. A rest area (20) is near the International College Building.

places.name: Other campus buildings
places.location: Seondang (23) is a traditional-style hall at the top middle of campus. Volunteer Service Hall (25) is next to the main road by the Student Welfare Building. The sports facilities management building (45) is next to the Sports Complex.

faq.question: What is the address of the university?
faq.answer: Tongmyong University is at 428 Sinseon-ro, Nam-gu, Busan, postcode 48520. In Korean: 부산광역시 남구 신선로 428.

faq.question: How do I get here by bus or subway?
faq.answer: City buses stop near campus: bus 8 goes to Yongho-dong and Namcheon-dong, 134 to Nampo-dong, 10, 68 and 583 to Seomyeon, and 1011 to Songdo, Yeongdo and Haeundae. The nearest subway stations are Daeyeon Station and Kyungsung University and Pukyong National University Station on Metro Line 2. A free school shuttle runs between those stations and campus on weekdays.

faq.question: What is the phone number of the university?
faq.answer: The main number is 051-629-3014. Admissions is 051-629-3011, the Global Education Center is 051-629-3018, and Busan International College is 051-629-2051.

faq.question: What are the dormitory rules and hours?
faq.answer: There are three dormitory buildings with 1,065 beds. The entrance is open 5 AM to 11:30 PM with your access card. Dorm dining: weekday breakfast 7:15 to 8:45 AM, weekend breakfast 7:30 to 9 AM, dinner 5:30 to 7 PM. Laundry costs 1,000 won to wash and 500 won to dry. The fee is about 1,900,000 won per semester. Building 3, for international students, is off campus at 147 UN pyeonghwa-ro.

faq.question: What colleges does the university have?
faq.answer: Tongmyong has the College of ICT Convergence, Companion Animal, Business Administration, Health Welfare and Education, Beauty Art, Architecture and Design, Media, Future Multidisciplinary Studies, and Busan International College, which teaches in English.

faq.question: How do I apply as an international student?
faq.answer: Apply online, then there is a document review and sometimes an interview. After you're accepted you pay tuition and receive your admission letter. The Global Education Center in Building 17, Room 304 can help, phone 051-629-3018.

faq.question: Who is the president of the university?
faq.answer: The president is Dr. Lee Sang-cheon, the 11th president, since April 2025. The university was founded by Dr. Kang Seok-jin.

faq.question: Is there help for students with disabilities?
faq.answer: Yes. There is a rest area for students with disabilities on the 1st floor of the Main Building, a club room on the 3rd floor of the Student Union Building, and an accessible dorm room on the 2nd floor of Dormitory Building 1. Accessible parking spots are marked around campus.

faq.question: Where is the campus map?
faq.answer: There's a campus map and a virtual tour on the university website, tu.ac.kr. Buildings are numbered 1 to 48, so just ask me about a building number.

faq.question: Who are you / what can you do?
faq.answer: I'm the Tongmyong University campus help robot. I can say hello and help you find buildings, offices and services on campus.
